captions: The first person walks up to the second person and gives him/her a hug around the shoulders, while the second person puts his/her arms around the first person's waist. Then the first person pats the second person softly on his/her back with his/her right hand.
A person takes a few steps forward towards the other person and reaches out both hands to embrace the other person's shoulders, while the other person hugs the person's waist.

One person opens his/her arms, leans forward at the waist, hugs the shoulders of the other person, and lightly pats his/her shoulders twice with his/her right hand. Then, the other person embraces his/her waist.
The first person raises his right hand, followed by the second person raising his right hand, and they give each other a high-five in the air.
Two people stand facing each other and raise their right hands above their heads. They both extend their hands and give each other a high-five.
Two people face each other, simultaneously raise their right hands, and clap their hands in front of their heads.

Two people walk towards each other. After they meet, the first person hugs the second person with his/her right hand on the left shoulder, and the second person hugs back around the waist with his/her right hand. As a result, the first person softly pats the second person on his/her back with the right hand while the second person pats the first person's waist with his/her right hand.
Two people walk towards each other, simultaneously extend their right hands, pat the other person's left arm first, then embrace each other's backs, and pat a few times.

Both people step forward at the same time, with one person raising his/her right hand to embrace the shoulders of the other person, while the other person embraces his/her waist and lightly pats it with his/her left hand.
